summary: Add a required boolean column marketing_opt_in to the account_user table using an expand stage with NOT NULL DEFAULT false, deploy the new version with a state‑only migration, retire the old version, and follow with a contract stage that explicitly sets the default to guarantee no NULLs remain.
write_consistency: The expand stage adds the column with a NOT NULL DEFAULT false, ensuring both old and new versions see False for existing rows; old version inserts will also receive False via the default, so writes remain consistent during the overlap.

stages.description: Add marketing_opt_in column with NOT NULL DEFAULT false to account_user.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

stages.description: Retire the old Saleor version; after this only the new version serves traffic.
Explicitly set the column default to false to guarantee no NULLs after retire.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET DEFAULT false;
